business_delta: A03 1.0.1 two-aircraft formation is retained. OperationProfile changes from SCHEDULED to RANDOM so IQTYD may reference user-defined COUNT03, with IPER=0 and IDISP=EQUIDIST to retain hour-8 simultaneous starts. IntegerDistributions adds one <IRECT> row, PFAC=1, PARAM1=0 lower and PARAM2=3 upper. SystemDeployment.QTYPS increases from 2 to 6 to accommodate up to three simultaneous two-aircraft missions. Seeds 02-32 differ from seed 01 only in Control.RSEED.
limits: Thirty-two excluded diagnostic seeds observed all four count outcomes and fixed the reproducibility panel. The six-aircraft supply deliberately removes capacity shortage from this count test; zero count produces no activated or started mission although a profile sentinel is created. Selected seeds cannot prove the population law, exact probability weights, independence, other count ranges, capacity-shortage behavior, GUI-only behavior or cross-engine parity.
